profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at 8th Light
profile.summary:
Full-stack developer building software with purpose — driven by impact, not output.
I’m passionate about crafting tools that foster connection, empower communities, and solve meaningful problems. Just as much as I care about writing thoughtful code, I value building strong, collaborative teams.

Skills: 
Frontend: React | Typescript | JavaScript | Next.js | HTML | SCSS 
Backend:  Spring | Kotlin | Java | Ruby | Node | SQL 
Testing: Jest |  React Testing Library | JUnit, | Cypress
Other: Docker | CI/CD | TDD | XP

On my free time, I volunteer at various tech meetups and conferences, like Women Who Code, Girls in Tech, and Learn Teach Code. I am also an active member of Hack for LA (since 2019) where I can combine my love computer programming with my desire to continuously make a positive social impact via various local projects with the LA County government.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Modernize how the U.S. Space Force tracks, analyzes, and controls space assets by building apps that increased user work efficiency from 25 min to 8 min per task and decreasing time to update sensor data by 98.3%
- Research and develop greenfield, full-stack, human-centered apps from scratch – from conception to production
- Own entire project and responsible for technical requirements gathering, architecture/API design, integration/ unit testing, implementation, CI/CD pipeline creation, and VMware TAS cloud services configuration
- Work daily in an intensively collaborative Pair Programming environment practicing Extreme Programming (XP) and Test Driven Development (TDD)
- Longest-tenured member actively proposing features and advising on technical feasibility to reduce risks
- Build starter library that reduced number of security requirements (SD Elements/OWASP) from 56 to 34, which helped other newly established app teams initiate more efficiently
- Establish org’s initial integration capabilities and patterns using pub/sub messaging and event-driven architecture
- Ensure security compliance, compatibility, and deployment across different levels of secure networks
- Onboard and train 11+ new developers in code base and team practices
- Recognized by peers and awarded the 2021 “Spirit of Section 31” Award


Frontend: React, TypeScript, React Testing Library, Jest, Cypress,  Material UI, Cesium
Backend: Kotlin/Java with Spring, JUnit, MySQL 
DevOps: VMware Tanzu App Services/Pivotal Cloud Foundry,  GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Concourse CI,  Docker, RabbitMQ
Agile: Extreme Programming (XP), Test Driven Development (TDD), Pair Programming
positions.insights: Skills: Extreme Programming · Spring Framework · React.js · TypeScript · Kotlin · Test Driven Development · Full-Stack Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Transit Demand Management Calculator Project (July 2019 - March 2022)
- Building LA County’s first TDM Calculator to help Real Estate Developers meet their TDM requirements (a new mandate proposal by LA Department of Transportation)
- Mentor junior developers and review pull request
- Implement new practices including database migrations and journey testing
- Improve Docker so devs can run Microsoft’s SQL Server on any OS for local development instead of shared DB
- Create push script for automated testing to encourage developers to test before pushing code
- Designing and writing software technical specifications
Tech Stack: React, Node, Javascript, SQL Server, Docker, Cypress

Jobs for Hope (April 2019 - July 2019)
- Generating new job board web solutions for the LA Office of Homelessness Initiative (Measure H)
- Active open source contributor to full-stack application to aggregate job opportunities with homeless service providers.
- Transforming wireframe layouts into responsive, user-friendly React.js web app
- Building responsive app for various devices and media queries
- Creating filters for scraped data from partnered organizations
- Contributing to frontend design and development for practical user experience while meeting business needs
Tech Stack: React, Node, Javascript, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Computer Programming Instructor (HS Summer Program)
positions.description:
- Teaching programming language fundamentals through UCLA's immersive Summer Discovery Program for high schoolers
- Creating custom web development curriculum that utilizes Python, HTML, CSS, Git, Github
- Leading class of 20 diverse high school students with different educational and cultural backgrounds
- Assisting with a secondary Unity course

positions.title: IT Project Coordinator
positions.description:
- Managed UAT efforts across 8 dept: user/business requirements, interviews, workflows, & test scripts
- Directed workflow of developer & engineering teams during 13-hr Disaster Recovery Test 
- Created technical user documentations and Unified Communications training materials
- Developed first Cyber-Security Training Program, deploying 49 training sessions for 752 employees, and capturing 99.47% participation within 2 months


Other Non-Technical Responsibilities:
- Revised 15 IT Policies & Procedures to clarify technical jargon, create consistency, and establish compliance
- Facilitated cross-functional meetings, ran reports, and ensured timely and appropriate implementation of project planning, communications, and deliverable
- Managed all IT related communications

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Managed and updated internal SharePoint website for the 300-member department
- Recognized as an unofficial IT technician, which led to IT Project Coordinator role

positions.title: Government Relations Intern
positions.description:
- Visited 25 legislators to lobby policies affecting the apartment industry 
- Researched and informed property managers about the current events and policies affecting them via newsletters
- Promoted, scheduled, and attended political candidate interviews, fundraisers, and events
- Updated and maintained members' information in database

company.name: Apartment Association of Greater Los Angeles

positions.title: Web Development Intern/Webmaster
positions.description:
- Assisted in the development of USC School of Business and USC Alpha Phi Omega websites
- Created wireframe designs to attract users through modern design, development, and UX
- Ensure user needs are met whilst fulfilling the key business and project objectives           	   
- Developed website using PHP, HTML/CSS, JQuery, mySQL for members to create, edit, and sign up for events
- Tested website performance and usability of Microsoft SharePoint website for quality assurance

honors.title: Fallen Heroes Scholarship
honors.description: The VAAFA Fallen Heroes Scholarship Fund was established in remembrance of the Vietnamese American U.S. Armed Forces service members who have given the ultimate sacrifice in defense of Freedom and Democracy for our great Nation. This Scholarship is intended to honor their service and to remember that it was their selfless devotion to duty that has enabled us to pursue our goals and dreams. Recipients received $1000 for their stellar academic achievement, devotion to community service, and desire to serve others.
honors.issuer: Issued by Vietnamese American Armed Forces Association · Aug 2010

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Omega
organizations.position: National Convention Steering Committee Member, Webmaster, Inter-chapter Chair, Banquet Coordinator · Jan 2011 - Present
organizations.description:
National Convention Steering Committee Member (Mar 2012 – Dec 2013)
• Prepared, coordinated, and administered the biennial national convention for 350 chapters across the US: to elect the National Board of Directors, to re-evaluate and change APO’s national legislation, and to develop leaders, promote friendship, and provide service; chaired the awards banquet  
Webmaster (Dec 2012 – May 2013)
• Developed and maintained website for current and potential Fraternity members at USC using PHP, HTML/CSS 
Inter-Chapter Chair (May 2012 – Dec 2013)
• Created and coordinated events with approximately 20 other chapters throughout California to network and develop relationships 
Banquet Coordinator  (Jan 2011 – May 2012)
• Planned, coordinated, and executed  the logistics and operations of the semi-annual chapter banquet
